definitions.explanation: The party selling something in a transaction, especially in contracts for property, cars and other large purchases.

examples.japanese: {売主|うりぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}する→交渉する：17189_koushousuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売主|うりぬし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The seller of this house lives abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{売主|うりぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The contract says that the seller bears the cost of repairs until handover.

notes:
USAGE:
A contract and real-estate word. In ordinary conversation people say ⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ or ⟦{売|う}り{手|て}→売り手：24769_urite⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買主|かいぬし}→買主：31855_kainushi⟧: buyer (the opposite party in a contract)
- ⟦{売|う}り{手|て}→売り手：24769_urite⟧: seller, the general word, also for markets (⟦{売|う}り{手|て}→売り手：24769_urite⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧, a seller's market)
